title: [Perks] LG 83" C6 Evo AI 4K OLED Smart TV (2026) $4752.80 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ In-Store) @ JB Hi-Fi (Excl. TAS)
body:
Deal: [Perks] LG 83" C6 Evo AI 4K OLED Smart TV (2026) $4752.80 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ In-Store) @ JB Hi-Fi (Excl. TAS)

[eggboi] Still happy with my 77” C5 for $2967 last year.
[LikezDaBargainz] I love how people neg the facts. I'll pass on "glass LG owns"
https://youtu.be/6IFVTcM28KA?si=GmW5WgWMOIhvETPP
[Rajserp] Just get root access and block it all. Plus you get some great homebrew features like Ad free youtube, HyperHDR / Hyperion with PiCap with ambilight control of from built in apps Netflix etc and HDMI sources.
[justtoreply] Doesn't sound easy. In my heyday, sure. Also, warranty.
[tunzafun001] How does one get ad free YouTube.
I avoid it totally these days with way over the top level of adds.
[DiscountForThee] I mean, it is still a really really good display?
[tp0] It has its issues like any TV. You have to decide which ones are the least concerning to you.
[DiscountForThee] I'm not saying it's a "literal perfect" display lol, I said it's "a really really good" display
[pharcyde] Oooof, great deal. They need to discount the 65" a bit.
[swiggity123] Yeah but sadly 65" is a very popular size now a days so incentive is less
[SickDmith] Bank owns the house.
LG owns the glass.
SONY owns digital games.
I need any hard liquor deal.
[He-Mania] Nope - according to lawyers who read the terms - LG still own it. Your just paying them to keep it in your house
[Blu2] Here's one way to lobotomise your smart tv btw (and void warranty, but the panels themselves are reliable in my experience). https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bwk99pZmhL0
You can use a $50 dongle to access apps like netflix and disney plus - which I hope doesn't have spyware either.
[Rivet] but the panels themselves are reliable in my experience
Hah, I wish! My 3 year old LG C2 is completely delaminating all along the right side of the panel. Google it, it's a very common issue after a few years apparently.
I did get extended warranty on it, so I'm going to try and get it sorted soon when I have time, but it's enough for me to never get an OLED again. I'm happy use Mini-LED until Micro-LED becomes the thing. My 55" TCL C755 has been pretty good, so I might even go looking for a bigger C8L soon.
Anyways, I agree with the lobotomising idea. WiFi boards are usually connected via simple ribbon cable from what I've seen, so shouldn't be destructive. Could also make for a good side hustle offering the service to people around your local area.
[Blu2] my 2021 lg C1 still going strong. But good to know
[Rivet] Yeah that's fair enough. Me saying it's a "very common issue" is a bit hyperbolic I suppose, so I'll take it back. Obviously people having issues are the loudest, and most people won't have issues. But it does suck ending up with a lemon.
Thanks for coming to my TED talk.
[solidussnake] My 77C1 has been rock solid with the exception of the PSU going outside of warranty in which LG acknowledged and repaired free of charge, also sent me a replacement remote at no charge also. Been very happy with it.
